findings.failure_scenario: The backlog M2.1 row's done-description says CapabilitiesTest proves the failure message 'names ADR-0008', but the assertion only checks hasMessageContaining("conditional writes") -- a message that dropped the ADR-0008 citation while keeping 'conditional writes' would still pass. Not a functional gap in the guard itself (throw/no-throw logic independently mutation-verified), just an unenforced part of the stated claim.
